- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. ## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0166f86ba29896dc08238613b88a19f048c69388`
Local-runs: none

Reviewed against card #21349 (body, triage direction `5947006439`, claim `5948514895`, the os-dev-report), PR #21389 (body as corrected, 4-file list, net diff against merge base `ee75aae1a8` with `origin/main`), the code the diff calls read at the head sha, `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` `### Schema migrations`, `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and the head's check-runs collapsed latest-per-name. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) Write paths closed by `deferSchemaDdl: true, readOnlyProbe: true` at the two call sites — right, with two inherited residues named.** Traced at the head:
- The artifact's inline seed: `bootSchemaStack` passes `skipSeedData: true` to `createStandaloneStack` whenever `deferSchemaDdl` is set (`schema-migrate.ts` L306); `AppPlugin.start` then suppresses the seed source and writes no rows (`app-plugin.ts` L1535-1542). This is the card's measured write (updated_at, organization_id, relative dates) and the source of the `sys_activity` view error; closed.
- Boot schema sync and the audit plugin's provisioning: `DeferSchemaDdlPlugin.init` arms `driver.setDeferredDdl(true)` before any `start()`; `SqlDriver.initObjects` then records each object into `deferredSchemaObjects` and `continue`s before `ensureRotation`, `hasTable`, create and alter (`sql-driver.ts` L12335-12338), and skips `ensureDatabaseExists` (L12320). `AuditPlugin.provisionSystemTables` runs at `kernel:ready` through `engine.syncObjectSchema` into that same `initObjects`, and nothing on a preview clears the flag (only `flushDeferredSchemaDdl` does), so `sys_audit_log` / `sys_activity` / `sys_comment` are recorded, not created; closed.
- SQLite create-if-absent: `readOnlyProbe` maps to `sqliteAbsentFile: 'empty-in-memory'` and suppresses the state-dir `mkdir` (`standalone-stack.ts` L659-660, L682); closed. Postgres/MySQL `CREATE DATABASE` sits inside `ensureDatabaseExists`, skipped under deferral; closed.
- The fresh-datastore attestation (`sys_migration` insert at `kernel:ready`, `platform-objects/src/plugin.ts` L241-260) requires `engine.wasDatastoreCreatedFromEmpty()`, which needs a `created` count above zero from `getSchemaSyncStats`; deferred `initObjects` never reaches `tablesCreatedHere.add`, so it stays false; closed. The dev did not list this one; verified here.
- "Checked and not a write path" claims: platform repair migrations are off unconditionally (`runPlatformMigrations: false`, pre-existing); no host config is composed on either command (`composeHostStack` is not passed, so no `onEnable`); `ensureOverlayIndex` is reached only from `saveMetaItem`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `listDrafts`, `publishPackageDrafts`, `discardPackageDrafts`, `revertCommit`, `rollbackMetaItem` — the preview's walk reads `sys_metadata` through `engine.find` directly and never enters those (the method's own docblock saying it "runs on EVERY boot" is stale against its callers; outside this surface). `MetadataPlugin` persists nothing on an artifact boot (`metadata/src/plugin.ts` L262).
- Residues the read-only boot leaves open, both inherited from the boot `os migrate plan` takes and neither introduced here: (1) the lifecycle sweep (`rotateShards`, retention reaping) is armed with `DEFAULT_LIFECYCLE_INITIAL_DELAY_MS = 60_000` on unref'd timers and stopped on destroy — the dev's "first run after the one-shot exits" is a time-bounded claim, true for every measured run, not a structural one; (2) `DeferSchemaDdlPlugin` arms deferral on the first `driver.*` SQL service only, so a second SQL datasource an artifact declares (including a lifecycle-class `telemetry` store that `sys_audit_log` / `sys_activity` route to) would still schema-sync. Not the card's shape (single-file SQLite, one live cell). Named for #21391's family-wide fix to weigh; no fix demanded here.
- ⛔ No skip list: confirmed, the diff adds no table list; `--apply` passes an empty spread and boots exactly as before.

**(b) Reuse of `os migrate plan`'s boot — right.** The two call sites pass the same two read-only options `plan.ts` passes (`deferSchemaDdl: true, readOnlyProbe: true`); `plan` additionally passes `composeHostStack: true` for its own object-set concern (#12938), which these DATA commands never took and still do not — they keep `extraPlugins` from `buildDataMigrationPlugins`, unchanged. `os migrate duplicates` is the exact-options sibling. One mechanism; `schema-migrate.ts`, `schema-migration-plugins.ts`, `data-migration-plugins.ts` and `packages/drivers` are untouched (the net diff is exactly the 4 listed files, 505 additions, 0 deletions).

**(c) The pins — right as delivered, with one unpinned declaration and one CI gap.** `preview-read-only.integration.test.ts` runs the real oclif commands against a database a plain boot seeded and an operator edited, carrying one legacy flow row and one cleartext audit copy. `readState` reads the schema (`sqlite_master` type/name/sql; on Postgres `information_schema.tables`/`columns` plus `pg_indexes`) and every row of every base table on a probe connection of its own, and the preview cases assert `toEqual(before)` — full-state equality, stronger than a row hash — while asserting the report still names the pending work (`pending: 1`; `sys_audit_log.rewritten: 1`), so the identity is not vacuous. Both `--apply --yes` controls are present and assert the rewrite landed. The missing-file edge runs for both commands on SQLite and asserts no file, `-wal`, `-shm` or `-journal`. Gap: that edge case does not assert the exit code or the refusal, so the declared narrowing (exit 1, the changeset's BREAKING line) has no pin. The CLI's `vitest run` executes both tier projects, so Test Core runs the SQLite cell; the live PostgreSQL cell is keyed on `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL`, a named skip without it and a failure under `OS_EXPECT_LIVE_DIALECT_MATRIX=1`. `ci.yml` supplies that URL to the driver-sql, metadata-protocol and runtime legs of Temporal Conformance only — never to `@objectstack/cli` — so in CI the live cell is a report, not coverage (the test header says so itself). The triage pin ("byte-identical on SQLite and on one live dialect") asked for the measurement; the report records it against a private PostgreSQL 16 (23 tests, 4 files, with the URL), and the wiring is outside the claim's file surface. Acceptable to land; the wiring is escalated below as a follow-up with no carrier today.

**(d) Changeset and PR prose — true at the head, two sentences qualified.**
- `deferSchemaDdl` implies `skipSeedData`: true (L306). "One spread per command, no new mechanism, no skip list, no driver change": true.
- The BREAKING edge: under deferral a read of a table in the driver's own deferred set is refused (`sql-driver.ts` L10198-10210); `migrateStoredMetadata` reads `sys_metadata` outside any try, so `meta.ts` catches and sets `exitCode = 1`; `migrateStoredMetadataBodyCopies` counts an unreadable table as a failure (`stored-metadata-body-migration.ts` L232-239) and `audit-metadata-bodies.ts` exits 1 when `failures` is above zero. The sentence is right.
- "The 17.6.0 upgrade checklist runs both previews before their `--apply` runs": at the head `17-6.mdx` L1589-1590 instructs `audit-metadata-bodies` then `--apply` literally; the meta step's imperative (L1578) is `--from 17` then `--stored --apply`, with the `--stored` preview named in its warning and the page's own known-issues entry (L1487) calling both "two previews in the upgrade checklist". True as the release page describes itself; on the stricter reading the meta preview is referenced, not instructed. Not a false sentence.
- "re-evaluated relative-date seed values": the card's HotCRM observation, not reproduced on app-crm (the PR's table names updated_at and organization_id only); a true property of the seed upsert, sourced from the card.
- "`minor` under the launch-window convention for accept-set narrowings": matches `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (a declared `narrowing` ships `minor` until GA).
- PR body: `meta --stored` landed in `83cf2d3082` (#4464) and `audit-metadata-bodies` in `336e191441` (#21144): both commits exist and touch those files; both CLI tags exist. "Lifecycle sweep: first run after the one-shot exits" holds for every measured run (60 s initial delay, unref'd); stated as time-bounded above. Acceptance notes 1-5 are each true: #21391 exists, open, labelled `finding`, and carries the two overstated comments (`schema-migrate.ts` runPlatformMigrations block and `platform-migrations-arming.integration.test.ts` L321-326 both still list `os migrate meta` among the non-deferred boots; after this PR that holds only with `--apply`); `cli.mdx` L1197 says the `--stored` preview "writes nothing" and has no `audit-metadata-bodies` entry.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/cli` `minor`, BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — right. The accept set of a public CLI surface shrank: a database lacking the table the preview reads was answered with exit 0 and is now refused with exit 1, observable to any script that ran the preview first. Under AGENTS.md's declaration rule `yes` takes at least `minor` and `(narrowing)` is BREAKING, so the banner and a disposition marker are owed; the launch-window guard grades it `minor`, not `major`. The category is the honest one: no authorable key, export or stored shape moves, nothing a consumer rewrites, and the operator remedy ("point `--database-url` at the deployment's database, or boot it once") is not a code prescription — the body carries no FROM/TO label, arrow rewrite or rewrite table for the detector to refuse. The claim's earlier `Clause-②: no` addressed the writes, not the exit code; the seat's patch round corrected the arm. Note the PR title keeps `fix(cli)`, and the commit type may raise a bump but never lower it, so `minor` stands.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Regression premise (17.5.0 wrote nothing): answered by the dev — the 17.5.0 CLI rewrote the same 28 rows on app-crm, twice, and `--stored` has booted this way since `83cf2d3082`. The HotCRM observation cannot be measured from this repository. ESCALATE to the release seat: `17-6.mdx` L1491 (RELEASE-OWNED) states "The 17.5.0 CLI's `--stored` preview wrote nothing", which the app-crm measurement contradicts for that app; both can be true per app (an inline seed is also skipped on a multi-tenant boot — `app-plugin.ts` L1544-1549 — which is a hypothesis, not a measurement). A docs-only PR or a release-notes note, never a rider here.
- Live PostgreSQL CI wiring: answered in acceptance note 4 and true (no leg supplies the URL to `@objectstack/cli`). ESCALATE as a follow-up card: today the cell has no carrier, and a named skip in CI will never go red for PG. One build step plus one run step in Temporal Conformance, with `OS_EXPECT_LIVE_DIALECT_MATRIX=1` scoped to the step, is the shape `ci.yml` already uses for runtime (#18734).
- Edge behaviour change (exit 1 where it exited 0): declared in the changeset as BREAKING and in the PR body; the mechanism is verified above. FLAG: not pinned — the SQLite missing-file case asserts only that no file appears. A one-line exit-code assertion is owed by whoever next touches this file; not a blocker, the declaration is the carrier the launch window relies on.
- Family finding: filed as #21391 (open, `finding`), one card for seven commands, with the dev's family-wide suggestion (seed off on every one-shot boot, DDL deferred on every dry run). Answered. The two residues named in ①(a) — the time-bounded lifecycle sweep and the default-driver-only deferral — belong on that card's design, not on this PR.
- The two overstated comments: carried by #21391 ("Also on this card (carrier)"); both files are outside this claim's surface. Answered.
- `--apply` still running the seed loader and schema sync: the direction keeps `--apply` unchanged; the dev noted it with no carrier; #21391's family-wide suggestion would cover it. Answered, no action here.
- `Fixes #21349`: right to close. The card names two commands and an expected outcome ("the file is unchanged"); both previews now leave schema and every row identical on the card's steps, the `sys_activity` view error goes with the seed, and the direction's pins exist (SQLite in CI, PG measured locally). The 17.5.0-regression framing did not reproduce but is not part of the fix; the family is #21391. The `Part-of PR must not also close its card` and `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` checks both passed on this head.
- Governed surfaces: none of the 4 files is one (`.changeset/`, `packages/cli/`), so the landing needs no record; this record is rendered because the seat asked.
- Check-runs on `0166f86ba29896dc08238613b88a19f048c69388`, collapsed latest-per-name, converged at 2026-10-02T10:36:02Z after three 5-minute polls (they had not converged at dispatch): 34 names, 29 `success`, 5 `skipped` (Auto Label, Build Docs, Check PR Size, Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke), 0 failed, 0 pending. All seven required contexts are `success`: Lint & Repo Gates (carrying `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:live-db-isolation`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`), TypeScript Type Check, Test Core (all six shards; this is where the new file's SQLite cell runs), Dogfood Regression Gate (three shards), Build Core, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Governed Surface Queue Guard. Also `success`: Check Changeset, Dogfood Verify CLI, the four Type Check lanes, the single-writer and claim checks. Cited from the converged snapshot only.
